<template>
  <el-form ref="formRef" :model="model" label-width="110px" :disabled="mode === 'view'">
    <el-form-item v-for="f in fields" :key="f.code" :label="f.label" :prop="f.code" :rules="f.required ? [{ required: true, message: f.label + '不能为空', trigger: 'blur' }] : []">
      <el-select v-if="f.type === 'select' || f.type === 'radio'" v-model="model[f.code]" clearable style="width: 100%">
        <el-option v-for="opt in f.options" :key="opt.value" :label="opt.label" :value="opt.value" />
      </el-select>
      <el-date-picker v-else-if="f.type === 'date-picker'" v-model="model[f.code]" type="date" value-format="YYYY-MM-DD" style="width: 100%" />
      <el-input-number v-else-if="f.type === 'input-number' || f.type === 'number'" v-model="model[f.code]" :controls="false" style="width: 100%" />
      <el-switch v-else-if="f.type === 'switch'" v-model="model[f.code]" />
      <el-input v-else v-model="model[f.code]" :type="f.type === 'textarea' ? 'textarea' : 'text'" clearable />
    </el-form-item>
  </el-form>
</template>

<script setup>
const props = defineProps({
  data: { type: Object, default: () => ({}) },
  mode: { type: String, default: 'add' },
  fields: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
  tableCode: String,
  formName: String,
  pageApi: Object
});
const model = ref({ ...props.data });
const formRef = ref();
watch(() => props.data, val => { model.value = { ...(val || {}) }; });
async function validate() {
  try { await formRef.value.validate(); return true; } catch { return false; }
}
async function getData() {
  return { ...model.value };
}
defineExpose({ validate, getData });
</script>

props.placeholder: 请输入模型标识（小写字母+下划线）
